frontier_ranked.question: Can public Qwen3.5 projected visual-token-grid descriptors meet Frank MVC open-set/calibration requirements without a private pre-merger feature tap or duplicate encoder?
frontier_ranked.capability_needed: target Qwen3.5-4B model/mmproj plus frozen user-specific GUI replay fixtures

frontier_ranked.question: Does target runtime execute exactly one image encode when MVC first reads the embedding buffer and semantic Qwen decode follows?
Is the L0/L1/L2/L3 lifetime split safer and smaller than a durable raw-embedding cache under restart/version/preprocess changes?
How must Qwen3.5 hybrid recurrent continuation state be versioned/recovered around multimodal prefixes?
Does coarse decoder-position-aware spatial pooling improve GUI-state discrimination without overfitting translation/resize?
Does PAR-1/EAP seeding add causal value after the feature/cache architecture is fixed?
frontier_ranked.reason: Experience-dose claim requires independent Frank episode fixtures; current feature/runtime identity uncertainty is upstream and more discriminating.

closed_or_narrowed: Qwen3.5 multimodality itself is not an open q23 question; it is established project/runtime input.
A second heavy multimodal embedding model is not the right first counterbaseline; use tiny MobileCLIP2-S0 and dense DINOv3-S/16 before considering 2B retrieval models.
A private decoder hook is not required merely to feed already-calculated image embeddings into llama.cpp decode; current helper code provides that path.
